inventory_method.scope: Every rs/*/src directory whose package has src/lib.rs. Source syntax across cfg branches, not a compiled-feature count. Generated macro output is not expanded.
inventory_method.test_owned_lines: Union of source lines covered by items requiring positive cfg(test), recognized test function attributes, or modules reachable only through such test-only declarations. Includes comments/blank lines inside those spans. Shared cfg(any(test, feature=...)) support is not itself test-only.
inventory_method.private_sibling_name_hits: A syntactic test body contains an identifier matching restricted-visibility items collected from its enclosing module, excluding items with explicit positive cfg(test) attributes. Token matching is not compiler name resolution: shadowing/reexports or inherited test scopes can overcount, and private fields/methods/helpers/macro expansion can undercount. This is a review inventory, not a certified private-use count.
